platformPrerequisites: Android PackageManager MAIN + CATEGORY_LAUNCHER visibility
tools.description: Find only enabled exported public MAIN/LAUNCHER apps matching a nonempty query against app label, package or launcher activity class. Returns at most 20 matching items, never a complete package inventory. Use for requested app discovery instead of broad pm list packages. A Citra query can match a Lime3DS launcher activity whose class contains org.citra. No shell or elevated privilege.

platformPrerequisites: Android PackageManager MAIN + CATEGORY_LAUNCHER visibility
tools.description: Launch one discovered package using only its enabled exported MAIN/CATEGORY_LAUNCHER activity onto the currently resolved selected screen display. No arbitrary component, URI, extras, shell, data/task clearing or launching the assistant itself. Requires screen_control and fresh target authorization; no ADB permission or gray-shell approval is needed. A submitted launch is not foreground proof: immediately observe app/window/UI or capture a fresh screen before the next input. After successful submission, automatically returns a fresh screenshot and frameId when screen perception is enabled and capture is available. Use that image for the next action; an extra capture_screen call is unnecessary. If postActionScreenshot=false, inspect screenshotError and observe again without blindly replaying the action.

platformPrerequisites: Attached assistant runtime background callback; fixed main-thread Activity.moveTaskToBack(true) when chat is visible
tools.description: Move only the Thor Agent chat task into the background so the authorized Run can continue controlling calibrated screens. Takes no package, task, display, command or navigation arguments. Does not start a target app, change screen roles, or alter focus settings. Already hidden chat returns alreadyBackground=true without submitting input. After actual movement, re-observe and explicitly select the desired screen role before further input.

platformPrerequisites: Accessibility
tools.description: Enumerate bounded Accessibility windows only on the calibrated selected screen display.

platformPrerequisites: Accessibility
tools.description: Read a compact semantic Accessibility tree of the current selected screen app, including exposed offscreen nodes. Passwords hidden. Returns snapshot-bound nodeRef, parent/scroll relationships, actions and collection/range metadata. Never auto-scrolls or reveals unexposed virtualized/hidden content. Use maxDepth up to 20, query, visibility and offset to page current exposed evidence; each read is a new observation and invalidates old refs. Scroll using a returned scrollable nodeRef, then observe again. For a long exposed TextView, query returns a snippet near the hit; textStart/textLength indicate clipping. textOffset reads later text without scrolling. Offscreen text evidence does not imply actual viewport movement.

platformPrerequisites: Accessibility
tools.description: Capture calibrated selected screen display via Accessibility into a bounded private JPEG attachment.

Read-only screenshot of the calibrated lower companion display ONLY when its unique visible application window belongs to the current authorized upper app. Useful for a dual-screen emulator presenting game controls, dialogs or status on its second screen. Never accepts displayId or input; refuses own assistant, other apps, ambiguous windows, overlays and secure windows. Captures only that app’s visible rectangle. Image has a separate companionObservationId/companionImageTransform, readOnly=true, frameInputUsable=false and NO frameId. Returned targetSnapshotId remains a fresh UPPER observation; never reuse companion pixels or coordinates for upper input. Uses native Accessibility screenshot only; no shell/root fallback.

tools.description: Select the calibrated upper or lower screen as THIS RUN’s next observation/input target. New runs default to upper. Does not change global calibration, another Run or permissions. Different apps on the two screens are allowed; lower refuses the assistant itself, ambiguous/occluded apps, visible password fields and secure windows. Returned snapshotId/targetSnapshotId and displayRole bind this selected role; after success re-observe that screen in the next tool round before input. Old upper/lower frames and nodeRefs cannot cross roles. Accepts only screen upper|lower, never a numeric displayId. SCREEN_CONTROL is still independently required for any actual input.
Read requested system/display/resource SDK data; never use Shell.

Activate a current ui_tree clickable node using its advertised ACTION_CLICK, without guessing coordinates. Only nodeRef is accepted. Native resolves the same unique tree path and node identity again and requires its own signature, bounds, app/window, display/epoch and visible region unchanged. Unrelated content updates such as a sibling RAM counter may change; target changes, stale refs, other runs/sessions, new screen observations or prior input invalidate the ref. Never activates offscreen/password/disabled/nonclickable nodes; choose a visible clickable ancestor if needed. No arbitrary accessibility actions, coordinates, text or value injection. Submission is not proof of app effect; re-observe afterward. After successful submission, automatically returns a fresh screenshot and frameId when screen perception is enabled and capture is available. Use that image for the next action; an extra capture_screen call is unnecessary. If postActionScreenshot=false, inspect screenshotError and observe again without blindly replaying the action.
platformPrerequisites: Current run/session latest ui_tree ref
Same selected screen display, app, window, layout and visible region
Unchanged visible enabled clickable non-password target with ACTION_CLICK
Accessibility on the selected screen; current ui_tree nodeRef of a visible enabled non-password editable field with ACTION_SET_TEXT
tools.description: Enter real Unicode text (including Chinese, emoji and newlines) into one current selected-screen editable field through ACTION_SET_TEXT. nodeRef must come from a fresh ui_tree and retains Run/session/window/app/node identity and visible bounds checks. Default insert replaces the current selection, inserts at a cursor, or appends when both selection endpoints are unavailable; replace replaces the full field and empty text clears it. text is at most 4096 Unicode code points; insert result is at most 65536 UTF-16 units, invalid or split-surrogate selections are rejected. This changes the field only: no automatic Enter, IME action or submission. Observe the screen/UI again before the next action. Password fields and hidden/offscreen fields are not supported. After successful submission, automatically returns a fresh screenshot and frameId when screen perception is enabled and capture is available. Use that image for the next action; an extra capture_screen call is unnecessary. If postActionScreenshot=false, inspect screenshotError and observe again without blindly replaying the action.

platformPrerequisites: Shizuku shell UID 2000 grant; verified selected-screen application keyboard focus; fixed Android keyboard injection backend
tools.description: Send one bounded keyboard DOWN/UP pair with optional distinct CTRL, ALT, SHIFT and META modifiers to the verified focused application on the selected screen. Fixed allowlist only: A-Z, 0-9, ENTER, TAB, BACKSPACE, DELETE, ESCAPE, SPACE, UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT, HOME/END and PAGE_UP/PAGE_DOWN. HOME/END move within text; no Android system HOME, arbitrary numeric keycodes, shell commands, power/volume keys, repeat or holds. All attempted keys and modifiers receive UP cleanup even after cancellation. Keyboard events are not gamepad events and do not type arbitrary Unicode: use input.type_text for Chinese/emoji or multi-character text. Enter is sent only when explicitly requested, so observe the result before using it to submit. Observe screen/UI again after each action. After successful submission, automatically returns a fresh screenshot and frameId when screen perception is enabled and capture is available. Use that image for the next action; an extra capture_screen call is unnecessary. If postActionScreenshot=false, inspect screenshotError and observe again without blindly replaying the action.

Send one fixed Android BACK down/up pair to the currently authorized selected screen display and that display’s focused target app/window (global focus may belong to the lower display). Use for Android back navigation or an app menu implemented by onBackPressed; an edge swipe or gamepad BUTTON_MODE is not equivalent. No arbitrary keycode, HOME, shell, display override, hold, repeat, URI or extras. This is virtual-keyboard Android navigation, never physical gamepad identity. Returns submitted but foregroundVerified=false; re-observe after navigation. Requires normal screen_control, not a separate adb_debug capability; bound shell backend still needs its actual Shizuku grant. After successful submission, automatically returns a fresh screenshot and frameId when screen perception is enabled and capture is available. Use that image for the next action; an extra capture_screen call is unnecessary. If postActionScreenshot=false, inspect screenshotError and observe again without blindly replaying the action.

platformPrerequisites: Shizuku shell UID 2000 grant
Unique writable Odin Controller evdev node, reported button label/state, and verified firmware key layout
Authorized selected screen app is the physical controller focused target; requested button initially released
tools.availabilityPolicy: ready only when the fixed physical evdev backend is writable and its controller profile is validated; InputManager event identity is not a fallback
tools.description: Press and automatically release a real Odin controller button using a fixed EV_KEY+SYN evdev frame. Use phase=hold only, durationMs default 100 and maximum 5000. Firmware key layout and actual getevent button label/state must be verified; an initially pressed button is rejected. Physical controller input follows verified selected screen-app focus, not displayId injection. Never keyboard/touch/InputManager fallback. Stop releases only this action through its original fd; SIGKILL cannot guarantee release. Independently verify receiver source/deviceId and down/up before claiming effect.

platformPrerequisites: Shizuku shell UID 2000 grant
Unique writable Odin Controller evdev node and verified six-axis min/max/key layout
Authorized selected screen app is the physical controller focused target; requested axes initially neutral
tools.availabilityPolicy: ready only when the fixed physical evdev backend is writable and its controller profile is validated; InputManager MotionEvent is not an axis fallback
tools.description: Hold bounded physical Odin controller axes and automatically return requested axes to neutral. Only X/Y (left stick), Z/RZ (right stick), GAS/BRAKE (triggers) are supported after discovering real firmware ranges. Sticks accept -1..1, triggers 0..1; durationMs 1..5000. Uses a fixed EV_ABS+SYN evdev writer, not MotionEvent injection. Physical controller input follows verified selected screen-app focus; displayId alone cannot route evdev events. Non-neutral requested axes, changed controller, unavailable routing evidence or wrong focus are rejected without changing focus locks. Stop writes neutral to this action original fd. SIGKILL cannot guarantee release; independently verify real controller source/deviceId and neutral at the receiver.
Clean up only this Run-owned inputs; submitted Accessibility gestures cannot be instantly retracted.

No shell scripts/operators. Use debug.command_policy to classify first.

platformPrerequisites: Shizuku shell UID 2000
tools.description: Read or set AYN Thor upper/lower screen brightness independently through its firmware controller. Read adb-operations Skill and references/thor-brightness.md first. Both read and bounded set are white: no UI approval needed. Native resolves the real display ID; value and all returned brightness values are integer percentages 0..100 (unit=percent); Native privately converts to firmware units. Reject fractional or out-of-range values. Use this tool for ordinary brightness adjustments; generic shell commands retain their documented native units. Read both screens before/after and restore when testing.

tools.description: Read-only bounded directory listing with pagination. auto routes absolute shared-storage paths to Shizuku and relative paths to the synthetic config root; no diagnostic test directory is required. Shared reads cover /sdcard, /storage/emulated/<current-user> and accessible removable volumes, subject to actual OS permissions. Report missing/denied paths accurately; shell identity does not imply /data or other apps private files are readable. No per-read UI approval once adb_debug is enabled. Use path=/storage to discover accessible configured primary/removable roots; this is a virtual listing, not a scan of other users storage.
